title: Choose the visual world for M365 Admin
question: The roll assigned Lobby Directory. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Lobby Directory
options.lineage: black felt letterboards listing the tenants in an office-building lobby
options.thesis: The sidebar is the building's tenant board: you always read which tenant you are standing in.
options.viewport: Felt-black sidebar rail with the active tenant set in white condensed caps inside a brass-edged strip; light warm-grey work area with KPI row, recent users table and sync status panel.
options.risk: Literal reading of the word tenant; turns kitsch if letter texture leaks into the work area.

raised.raise: Each nav group owns one colour tick used everywhere that group's pages appear, so colour does wayfinding, not decoration.
Results of bulk actions hold their highlight until the operator acknowledges them.
Every page shares one fixed header frame and scale, so pages compare at a glance.

options.label: Hanging File Drawer
options.lineage: Pendaflex hanging folders with coloured plastic index tabs
options.thesis: Each tenant is a folder pulled forward; nav groups are its coloured index tabs.
options.viewport: Pressboard-green sidebar with nav groups marked by coloured tab chips; manila-tinted header carries the active tenant like a folder label.
options.risk: Tab colours can read toy-like if they spread beyond markers.

options.label: Dark-first Console
options.thesis: Graphite panels split by hairline seams; destructive actions sit apart on purpose.
options.viewport: Graphite shell, persistent panels, tenant and status in a top strip, Bulk delete isolated with outline style.
options.case: Holds clarity and fits a technical ops team; loses on tenant identification, nothing says which tenant you are in.
options.risk: Generic dark admin look; eye strain on long daytime shifts.

options.label: Split-flap Concourse
options.thesis: Status rows flip in place like a departure board; columns never move.
options.viewport: Steel-grey shell; recent users and sync status set as a fixed-column board with amber delayed rows.
options.case: Strong for live status; competes with the assigned board on identification, weaker on calm daily navigation.
options.risk: Per-character motion becomes noise on a screen used all day.

options.label: Midnight Transit Diagram
options.thesis: Nav groups as coloured lines with station stops.
options.case: Fuses poorly: operators do not think of admin tasks as journeys.
options.kept: One colour per group, applied consistently.

options.label: Boarding Pass & Gate Board
options.case: Fuses poorly: admin work is not ordered by departure time.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.thesis: Same plate, same scale, every stage.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no link to tenant administration.
options.risk: Editorial costume on a working screen.
options.kept: One fixed frame and scale across pages.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Importance as dot size on a fixed ramp.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no data here is spatial.
options.kept: A single fixed ramp for importance.

canonCard.label: Microsoft 365 admin standard
canonCard.thesis: The Fluent admin-center look your current screenshots follow, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: White sidebar with grouped nav, light dashboard with KPI cards and tables.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every M365 tool by design.
